A: Per the "Trial extensions – CoreSupport" KB, the standard trial is 14 days; agents may grant a one-time extension of up to 7 additional days per account when the customer requests it before the trial expires and the account meets the KB’s eligibility criteria.

rounds.response:
Q: What if the customer asks for a CoreSupport trial extension after the trial has already expired? A: Per the "Trial extensions – CoreSupport" policy, do not backdate or restart expired trials—agents must not grant post-expiry extensions on their own and should follow the escalation process for any exception.  
You can still:  
- Confirm the trial end date, whether the account already used its one-time +7‑day extension, and the account’s standing.  
- Offer alternatives such as scheduling a product demo, connecting them with Sales for reactivation options, or discussing paid plans.  
Escalate to your supervisor/Retention if the customer requests a post-expiry discretionary exception, asks to backdate/restart a trial, requests more than the standard limits, or the account is flagged or enterprise/contracted.
